title: Credentials-file discipline (0o400 host mode, secretRef, not committed, grep-refuse, no leak in event bodies)
asA: shelf consumer applying edge-cloudflare-tunnel v1.0.0 on a cloudHost
iWant: the tunnel credentials file to land at mode 0o400 on the host, be referenced from the manifest as a secretRef, never be committed to the applying tree (grep-refuse on the tunnel id and account tag literals), and never appear in any lifecycle event body
soThat: a leaked credentials file cannot happen through a review-time miss

acceptanceCriteria.description: The fixture credentials placeholder documents the 0o400 host mode and secretRef pattern; the manifest references the credentials via a secretRef; the grep-refuse pattern is documented in the guide; every cloudflaredReady, tunnelConnectorUp and ingressRuleReloaded event body captured by the in-process facade carries metadata only, and SIMULATE_EVENT_SECRECY_LEAK inserts the credentials literal into a lifecycle event body and the scan FAILS naming the leaked field.

Given the provisioned host file at the credentialsFile secretRef path, when the credentials-file host mode is inspected, the file exists at mode 0o400 owned by the cloudflared user; a fixture-induced mode of 0o600 or 0o644 refuses the probe with a stable code credentials.host-mode-drift naming the observed mode.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the provisioned host fixture with the credentials file rendered from the secretRef
acceptanceCriteria.when: the credentials-discipline probe stats the credentials-file path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file at mode 0o400 owned by the cloudflared user passes; induced 0o600/0o644 refuses with credentials.host-mode-drift

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the applying-tree git working set, when the grep-refuse scan walks every tracked file for the tunnel-id and account-tag literal substrings, no tracked file matches (the credentials remain out of the tracked tree); a fixture that commits a credentials JSON body refuses the probe with a stable code credentials.tracked-tree-leak naming the offending path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applying-tree git working set with the tunnel id and account tag known from the manifest
acceptanceCriteria.when: the credentials-discipline probe greps every tracked file for the two literal substrings
acceptanceCriteria.then: no tracked file matches on the canonical fixture and the fixture-induced committed-credentials variant refuses with credentials.tracked-tree-leak
